claims.statement: After the user authorizes the app, Canva sends an authorization code to the redirect URL; the app exchanges it, with the code_verifier, at the token endpoint.

sources.supports: After the user authorizes your app, you'll receive an authorization code at your specified redirect URL.
code string Required The authorization code you received after the user authorized the app.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Whether the authorization code is a credential family worth a boundary of its own (single-use and short-lived, but held as a string) is unresolved; no format is stated and the example value in the documentation is not copied. The PKCE code_verifier (43 to 128 characters of ASCII letters, digits, and - . _ ~, per the authentication guide) is client-generated, not Canva-issued, and is not recorded as a family.
